subject: clockworkDog

Still defining gear geometry...

Adding brass band details around the torso using slightly oversized boxes to simulate wrapped bands, plus a row of small rivet spheres along the sides for texture, and deciding to skip a wooden base plinth to keep the model simpler before finalizing the code.
